codebaseAuditGotchas.issue: Exalted weapon path & zeroed package stats
codebaseAuditGotchas.detail: Actual path is /Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraShankWeapon (Prime: GaraShankWeaponPrime), NOT GlassShank. In Packages.bin_H / melee-mechanics.json, Amount=0, crit=0, procChance=0; GlassShank.lua (PseudoExaltedAdditionalStats) injects runtime base=400, critChance=0.20, critMult=2.0, procChance=0.30.

Actual weapon path is /Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/SlingerPistols (Prime: PrimeSlingerPistols), parent SlingerPistolsBase -> LotusCustomAimWeapon, NOT CowgirlPistols. Mesa's Waltz is /Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/GunFuPvPAugmentCard (IsUtility=1 Exilus).

codebaseAuditGotchas.issue: Prism Guard missing from warframe_build_data.json mods list + Eclipse-Prism hook
codebaseAuditGotchas.detail: Prism Guard is /Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/PrismPvPAugmentCard (converted to PvE in U27.4, 4s*Duration follow above head), omitted from warframe_build_data.json due to PvP filename. Also Solar Eclipse does NOT give +200%*STR weapon mult to Prism; instead Light.lua/Prism.lua (lightAbilityState) doubles Prism's per-hit ramp from +25% to +50%, while Lunar Eclipse halves Prism activation/drain cost (25 + 5/s).

codebaseAuditGotchas.issue: Explosive Legerdemain 60s built-in gem lifetime, non-heavy pickup whitelist, static cover LoS & Hall of Mirrors 4 smaller jewels
codebaseAuditGotchas.detail: HarlequinObjectChangeHelper.txt whitelists ONLY HealthIncrease, EnergyIncreaseSmall/Large, AffinityIncrease, and Pistol/Rifle/Shell/Sniper/AllAmmoPickup (excluding HeavyWeaponAmmoPickup and Universal Orbs). HarlequinObjectChange.lua Function #63 (AugmentMines) sets R8 := 60 (60.0s built-in lifetime unaffected by Ability Duration, refreshed on recast, persisting across waves) with 15m fixed explosion radius, 100% linear falloff, and checkForCover=true, staticCoverOnly=true LoS check. Simultaneously, Function #52 & Function #68 spawn 1 primary MiragePresentDeco jewel (20s fixed lifespan, 200*Strength DT_EXPLOSION, 8m*Range blast/blind, 12m*Range charm) PLUS 4 MiragePresentWeakDeco smaller jewels at 6m offset when Hall of Mirrors (harlequinLightClones) is active, scaled by packageWeakMultiplier = 0.5 (50% damage 100*Strength, 50% blast/blind radius 4m*Range, 50% charm radius 6m*Range, 50% blind duration 2.5s*Duration).
Packages.bin_H (EnergyConsumptionOverTime: 3.5) and Wiki both confirm 3.5 energy/s base drain, whereas warframe_build_data.json had 3.0.
